title: Friend abducted by grays, shows delta-pattern marks

tellings.quote: he said, "I forgot to tell you. They came and got me."

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that last spring a friend at his house suddenly told him, "I forgot to tell you. They came and got me." According to Alberino, the friend meant he had been taken by grays, the small gray-skinned beings common in alien abduction stories, and showed marks on his body laid out in a triangle-like pattern. If true, the marks would be physical traces left by such a visit.
